arguments.rule_content:
title: Lateral Movement to Critical Infrastructure via NTLM
id: 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-7g8h-9i0j-1k2l3m4n5o6p
description: Detects NTLM authentication from non-server hosts to critical network infrastructure (firewalls, routers, switches).
status: experimental
author: SOC Team
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1021/002/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1550/002/
tags:
    - attack.lateral_movement
    - attack.t1021.002
    - attack.t1550.002
    - dfir.mitre.lateral_movement
logsource:
    category: authentication
    product: windows
    service: security
detection:
    selection:
        EventID: 4624
        LogonType: 3
        AuthenticationPackageName: NTLM
        DestinationHostname|endswith:
            - '.firewall.corp.local'
            - '.router.corp.local'
            - '.switch.corp.local'
        SourceHostname|notendswith: '.server.corp.local'
    time_window: 5m
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative access
    - Authorized penetration tests
    - Maintenance window activities
level: high
# Improvement: Add exclusion for hosts/IPs in active Red Team engagements or maintenance windows
